title: Balsa theme adapter
description: How one upstream registry item is carried into the Balsa design system, which dimensions reach it, and what it costs. A patch records the source it was written against so an upstream change is detected rather than silently mis-applied.

item.description: Fully qualified upstream reference, for example @shadcn/button.

wave.description: Integration wave this item belongs to, ordered by how much of an application's surface the group covers.

status.description: compatible: standard variables work but integration is incomplete. integrated: complete through stable styling hooks. integrated-with-patch: complete, and Balsa applies a styling-only source patch. balsa-alternative: a separate Balsa implementation is provided instead. legacy: maintained for migration only. unsupported: not certified.

version.description: Version declared by the upstream registry, when it declares one.

files.description: Per-file hash of the upstream source this adapter was written against.

requires.description: What the component needs to build, measured from its source rather than read off the registry item. A registry may under-declare its dependencies, and an install that trusts the declaration reports a clean result for a component that cannot resolve its own imports.

npmDependencies.description: Union of what the registry item declares and what its files import.

undeclaredUpstreamDependencies.description: Packages the source imports that the registry item does not declare. Present only when upstream under-declares.

siblingImports.description: Specifiers pointing at shadcn's own repository layout, which the installer rewrites to this project's aliases. Not dependencies, but the case that breaks when the rewrite is wrong.

dimensions.description: How each Balsa design-system dimension reaches this component.

patches.description: Styling-only replacements. Each must be an exact, unique match in the named file.

portal.description: Whether the component teleports content, and what the design system does about it.

findings.description: Static conformance findings measured on the patched source. Absent means none were found; it is not a claim of visual conformance.

reach.description: bridge: standard shadcn variables. adapter-scope: Tailwind theme variables under [data-balsa-adapt]. patch: a styling-only source patch. unsupported: cannot be carried, see the design-system manifest for why.
